info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Human Resource Management Workforce Contract-spec
info.description: The Workforce Contracts Management API facilitates the creation and management of workforce contracts within human resource systems. This API allows businesses to define terms, conditions, and specifics of workforce agreements for their employees. Common users include HR professionals and operational managers looking to streamline contract management processes. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure compliance and improve efficiency in their workforce contract handling.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new workforce contract within the human resource management system. You will need to provide the necessary details for the contract, and upon successful creation, you'll receive a confirmation along with the contract information.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating new workforce contracts within the human resource management system. Ensure that all required fields are included as per the schema to successfully create a new contract.

201.description: Resource created successfully, indicating that the workforce contract has been added.
